Comau introduces Hygienic Oil robot family for food and beverage lines

The Cibus Tec introduction combines NSF H1 food-grade lubricants with examples linking production and warehouse automation.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗27 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A new food-industry family

Comau introduced Hygienic Oil, or HO, at Cibus Tec in Parma, October 27–30. The range covers Rebel SCARA, Racer, NJ and palletizing robots using NSF H1 food-grade lubricants to reduce contamination risk. Lubricant selection alone does not establish direct-food-contact approval for every model.

From handling to palletizing

Displays include the four-axis S-18-1.7 HO, a partner-integrated Racer5 SE cell and a MyCo cell handling packaged products. Comau distinguishes HO from its FCM/MOCA food-contact range, so factories must select equipment against their particular processes and requirements.

Connecting production and storage

Automha shows the four-direction Quaterways shuttle with AWMS and Autosat GTR for multi-depth storage. The combined offering connects production, packaging and warehousing. Common pricing and standardized throughput across the displayed cells are not supplied; integration needs assessment against actual products.
